VAR-subnatid1.why: Region code (1-5 Bangkok/Central/North/Northeast/South) appears to be highest-level admin division in this survey (see reg).
Region also present on household-level table; may be same admin level as reg in rec02.

VAR-subnatid2.why: Changwat (province) numeric code with 76 categories; likely 2nd-level subnational ID below region.
Changwat also present on household-level table; may carry same province code.

VAR-subnatidsurvey.why: Most granular explicit geographic identifier seen is Changwat (province) code; plausible 'lowest level of Subnational ID' collected.
Province code repeated on rec01; may also serve as the survey's lowest collected subnational ID.

VAR-urban.why: Administrative Area coded Municipal vs Non-municipal; could be used as an urbanicity proxy if no explicit urban/rural variable exists.
Same Municipal vs Non-municipal area indicator on rec01; possible urban/rural proxy.

VAR-geocode.why: Geocode is derived from the survey's lowest collected subnational ID; cwt (province) is the likely input to a geography crosswalk.

VAR-gauladm1code.why: GAUL admin codes are derived from VAR-geocode; cwt (province) is the likely source ID used for crosswalking.

VAR-gauladm2code.why: GAUL admin codes are derived from VAR-geocode; cwt (province) is the likely source ID used for crosswalking.
